cards.description_ru: Технология нейроморфной обработки визуальной информации применяется для ускорения процесса инспекции изделий, например, контроля зенковок в автоматизированных производственных линиях аэрокосмической и автомобильной отраслей [doc:1]. Традиционные методы требуют остановки робота для каждой проверки из-за высокой задержки и неопределенности измерений, тогда как нейроморфные датчики способны ускорить этот процесс в 10 раз благодаря новым алгоритмам компенсации движения и кластеризации событий [doc:1]. Также разработаны специализированные датасеты для сегментации объектов в сложных условиях закрытых помещений, содержащие миллионы аннотированных событий и RGB-кадров [doc:2].
cards.advantage_ru: Использование нейроморфных датчиков позволяет значительно повысить скорость инспекционных процессов за счет снижения задержек и повышения точности оценки параметров изделий даже при низкой разрешающей способности камер.
cards.case_example_ru: Исследователи предложили метод обнаружения зенковок на основе компенсации движения событий и принципа кластеризации сдвигов среднего значения, ускоряющий процесс инспекции в 10 раз относительно традиционных подходов [doc:1].

Эти показатели свидетельствуют о том, что технология пока недостаточно распространена и находится на ранних стадиях внедрения.

sources.title: High Speed Neuromorphic Vision-Based Inspection of Countersinks in Automated Manufacturing Processes
sources.summary_ru: Статья рассматривает применение нейроморфных датчиков для быстрой инспекции зенковок в автоматизированном производстве, предлагая алгоритмы компенсации движения и кластеризации событий, повышающие точность и скорость процесса .
sources.snippet: Countersink inspection is crucial in various automated assembly lines, especially in the aerospace and automotive sectors. Advancements in machine vision introduced automated robotic inspection of countersinks using laser scanners and monocular cameras. Nevertheless, the aforementioned sensing pipelines require the robot to pause on each hole for inspection due to high latency and measurement uncertainties with motion, leading to prolonged execution times of the inspection task.

sources.title: A Neuromorphic Dataset for Object Segmentation in Indoor Cluttered Environment
sources.summary_ru: Представлен новый датасет для сегментации объектов в сложных помещениях с использованием стереоскопической конфигурации событийных камер, содержащий миллионы аннотированных событий и кадров .
sources.snippet: This paper proposes a new Event-based Segmentation Dataset (ESD), a high-quality 3D spatial and temporal dataset for object segmentation in an indoor cluttered environment. Our proposed dataset ESD comprises 145 sequences with 14,166 RGB frames that are manually annotated with instance masks. Overall 21. 88 million and 20. 80 million events from two event-based cameras in a stereo-graphic configuration are collected, respectively. To the best of our knowledge, this densely annotated and 3D spatial-temporal event-based segmentation benchmark of tabletop objects is the first of its kind.

cards.description_ru: Технология представляет собой искусственные нейроны и чипы для нейроморфных вычислений, использующие массивы резистивных синапсов. Каждый синапс имеет терминал распространения сигналов, объединённый с другими синапсами одного столбца и подключённый к искусственному нейрону [doc:1]. Также рассматриваются схемы смещения для одиночных устройств синаптических элементов [doc:2]. Исследуется гибридная био-физическая система синапса следующего поколения с использованием ДНК-оригами и двумерных материалов, таких как графен и нитрид бора, для обработки сигналов [doc:3].
cards.advantage_ru: Данная архитектура позволяет моделировать работу биологических нейронов и синапсов, обеспечивая энергоэффективность и высокую производительность при решении задач машинного обучения и искусственного интеллекта.
cards.case_example_ru: Исследовательский проект Chur-chin/Bio-Physical-Hybrid-Neuromorphic-Synapse реализует симуляцию нейроморфного синапса нового поколения с применением ДНК-оригами и двумерных материалов, таких как графен и нитрид бора, для пространственного кодирования фаз и обработки сигналов методом интерференции волн [doc:3].

Против слабого сигнала — значительная семантическая близость к эталонным слабым сигналам (0.8705) и наличие упоминаний двух организаций, что указывает на начальную стадию развития технологии [doc:3]. Решение основывается на совокупности этих признаков.

cards.description_ru: Фотонные резервуарные вычисления — это подход к искусственному интеллекту, использующий световые волны вместо электронных сигналов для обработки информации. Технология применяется для классификации сигналов, прогнозирования временных рядов и управления гиперзвуковыми системами [doc:1, doc:2, doc:3]. Она основана на использовании фотонных резервуаров — оптических систем, способных выполнять параллельные вычисления на высоких скоростях [doc:6].
cards.advantage_ru: Потенциальные преимущества фотонных резервуарных вычислений включают высокую скорость обработки данных, энергоэффективность и возможность реализации сложных алгоритмов машинного обучения с использованием оптических компонентов.

sources.summary_ru: Статья описывает платформу для фотонного квантового вычисления с высокой точностью операций и компонентами для масштабирования .
sources.snippet: Whilst holding great promise for low noise, ease of operation and networking, useful photonic quantum computing has been precluded by the need for beyond-state-of-the-art components, manufactured by the millions. Here we introduce a manufacturable platform for quantum computing with photons. We benchmark a set of monolithically-integrated silicon photonics-based modules to generate, manipulate, network, and detect photonic qubits, demonstrating dual-rail photonic qubits with $99. 98\% \pm 0.

sources.title: Scaling and networking a modular photonic quantum computer
sources.summary_ru: Представлена модульная фотонная квантовая компьютерная система Aurora, демонстрирующая функциональность и масштабируемость с использованием 35 фотонных чипов .
sources.snippet: Photonics offers a promising platform for quantum computing1–4, owing to the availability of chip integration for mass-manufacturable modules, fibre optics for networking and room-temperature operation of most components. However, experimental demonstrations are needed of complete integrated systems comprising all basic functionalities for universal and fault-tolerant operation5. Here we construct a (sub-performant) scale model of a quantum computer using 35 photonic chips to demonstrate its functionality and feasibility.

sources.snippet: Quantum computing aims at exploiting quantum phenomena to efficiently perform computations that are unfeasible even for the most powerful classical supercomputers. Among the promising technological approaches, photonic quantum computing offers the advantages of low decoherence, information processing with modest cryogenic requirements, and native integration with classical and quantum networks.

sources.snippet: Here we show a photonic computing accelerator utilizing a system-level thin-film lithium niobate circuit which overcomes this limitation. Leveraging the strong electro-optic (Pockels) effect and the scalability of this platform, we demonstrate photonic computation at speeds up to 1. 36 TOPS while consuming 0. 057 pJ/OP. Our system features more than 100 thin-film lithium niobate high-performance components working synergistically, surpassing state-of-the-art systems on this platform.

sources.summary_ru: We present a logical photonic qubit architecture based on a Noncommutative Twistorial Quadruple (CTNC). The twistorial state space is modelled as holomorphic data over $\CP^3$ endowed with an internal noncommutativity encoded by a skew tensor $\Theta^{\alpha\beta}$.
sources.snippet: The scheme functions as a cryogenics-free building block for robust photonic quantum information processing. This approach suggests a new route toward scalable, cryogenics-free photonic quantum processors grounded in noncommutative geometry.

sources.title: Fusion-based quantum computation
sources.summary_ru: The standard primitives of quantum computing include deterministic unitary entangling gates, which are not natural operations in many systems including photonics. Here, we present fusion-based quantum computation, a model for fault tolerant quantum computing constructed from physical primitives readily accessible in photonic systems.
sources.snippet: The standard primitives of quantum computing include deterministic unitary entangling gates, which are not natural operations in many systems including photonics. Here, we present fusion-based quantum computation, a model for fault tolerant quantum computing constructed from physical primitives readily accessible in photonic systems. These are entangling measurements, called fusions, which are performed on the qubits of small constant sized entangled resource states. Probabilistic photonic gates as well as errors are directly dealt with by the quantum error correction protocol.

sources.title: Broadband Unidirectional Visible Imaging Using Wafer-Scale Nano-Fabrication of Multi-Layer Diffractive Optical Processors
sources.summary_ru: Статья описывает создание широкополосного однонаправленного визуализатора на видимой части спектра с использованием многослойных дифракционных оптических процессоров, изготовленных методом нанофабрикации на уровне кремниевой пластины.
sources.snippet: This approach is enabled by deep learning-driven diffractive optical design with wafer-scale nano-fabrication using high-purity fused silica to ensure optical transparency and thermal stability. Our design achieves unidirectional imaging across three visible wavelengths (covering red, green and blue parts of the spectrum), and we experimentally validated this broadband unidirectional imager by creating high-fidelity images in the forward direction and generating weak, distorted output patterns in the backward direction, in alignment with our numerical simulations.

sources.title: Subwavelength Imaging using a Solid-Immersion Diffractive Optical Processor
sources.summary_ru: Исследуется метод субволновой визуализации фазовых объектов с помощью твердотельнопогруженного дифракционного оптического процессора, использующего слои кодера-декодера для преобразования высокочастотных сигналов в низкочастотные.
sources.snippet: Phase imaging is widely used in biomedical imaging, sensing, and material characterization, among other fields. However, direct imaging of phase objects with subwavelength resolution remains a challenge. Here, we demonstrate subwavelength imaging of phase and amplitude objects based on all-optical diffractive encoding and decoding.

sources.title: Multiplane Quantitative Phase Imaging Using a Wavelength-Multiplexed Diffractive Optical Processor
sources.summary_ru: Представлена методика количественного фазового изображения трехмерных объектов с использованием дифракционного процессора, мультиплексирующего длину волны, что позволяет получать фазовую информацию с разных осевых позиций.
sources.snippet: Quantitative phase imaging (QPI) is a label-free technique that provides optical path length information for transparent specimens, finding utility in biology, materials science, and engineering. Here, we present quantitative phase imaging of a 3D stack of phase-only objects using a wavelength-multiplexed diffractive optical processor.

sources.title: Meta-optical processors for broadband complex-field image operations
sources.summary_ru: Обсуждается метаповерхностный процессор для аналоговой обработки комплексных оптических полей, работающий в широком диапазоне видимого спектра и выполняющий операции типа обнаружения краев и распознавания образов.
sources.snippet: All-optical image processing provides a fast and energy-efficient alternative to conventional electronic systems by directly manipulating optical wavefronts. However, metasurface-based optical processors reported to date are often limited in functionality, operating bandwidth, or input modality, which restricts their adaptability across different image processing tasks. Here, we demonstrate a broadband metasurface platform capable of performing diverse analog image processing operations on both amplitude- and phase-encoded inputs.

sources.title: Photonic Reservoir Computing System for Pattern Recognition Based on an Array of Four Distributed Feedback Lasers
sources.summary_ru: Статья описывает систему фотонного резервуарного вычисления на базе массива лазеров для задач распознавания образов.
sources.snippet: In this paper, we propose an integrated neuromorphic photonic time-delayed RC scheme based on an array of four distributed feedback lasers (F-DFBs) with optical feedback and injection. Here, we investigate the feasibility of using larger laser arrays and shorter external feedback cavities to provide the RC system with more virtual nodes at the same processing speed, enabling it to handle more complex tasks. Additionally, we compare the performance of the systems with a single DFB (the S-DFB RC) and the F-DFBs RC through simulations and experiments involving iris recognition tasks.

sources.title: Performance-enhanced time-delayed photonic reservoir computing system using a reflective semiconductor optical amplifier
sources.summary_ru: Предложено использование полупроводникового оптического усилителя в архитектуре фотонного резервуарного вычисления для повышения точности предсказания и выравнивания сигнала.
sources.snippet: We propose a time-delayed photonic reservoir computing (RC) architecture utilizing a reflective semiconductor optical amplifier (RSOA) as an active mirror. The performance of the proposed RC structure is investigated by two benchmark tasks, namely the Santa Fe time-series prediction task and the nonlinear channel equalization task. The simulation results show that both the prediction and equalization performance of the proposed system are significantly improved with the contribution of RSOA, with respect to the traditional RC system using a mirror.

sources.title: Real-time all-optical signal equalisation with silicon photonic recurrent neural networks
sources.summary_ru: Рассматривается применение фотонного резервуарного вычисления для реального времени выравнивания сигналов в оптических коммуникациях с использованием кремниевых фотонных рекуррентных нейронных сетей.
sources.snippet: Photonic reservoir computing is a machine learning paradigm in which a recurrent neural network remains fixed while only the output weights are trained. This makes it a well-suited approach for high-speed signal equalisation in optical communication systems, offering a trainable, low-power, and low-complexity solution. However, achieving strong performance typically requires relatively large network sizes, as learning is confined to the output layer. To address this, we investigate the role of trainable input mappings alongside conventional output weight optimisation.

sources.title: Reservoir Computing perspective: dynamics, neuroscience, and physical systems
sources.summary_ru: Обзор подходов резервуарного вычисления, охватывающий математику, динамику, приложения в области распознавания образов, управления и моделирования физических процессов.
sources.snippet: Reservoir computing (RC) has emerged as a versatile computational framework that combines the expressive power of complex dynamics with remarkably simple learning mechanisms. This perspective reviews the fundamentals of RC, where a reservoir transforms temporal inputs into rich dynamical representations that can be efficiently decoded by a trained readout.

sources.snippet: In “Experimental realization of integrated photonic reservoir computing for nonlinear fiber distortion compensation,” Opt. Express 29, 30991-30997 (2021), Sackesyn et al. proposed the use of photonic computing to compensate for fiber nonlinearity of a single fiber span.

Исследования направлены на разработку новых катодных материалов, например, поликристаллических соединений на основе Na2FePO4F, способных обеспечивать высокую энергоемкость и эффективность аккумуляторов [doc:1][doc:4].
cards.advantage_ru: Преимущества натрий-ионных аккумуляторов включают повышенную безопасность эксплуатации благодаря меньшей склонности к возгоранию, улучшение экологической устойчивости производства и возможность эффективного использования в системах возобновляемой энергетики, таких как солнечные электростанции [doc:1].
cards.case_example_ru: Исследованы структурные параметры и синтез поликристалла Na2FePO4F различными методами, установлено, что материал демонстрирует энергоемкость 88 мАч/г и перспективен для использования в катодах натрий-ионных аккумуляторов [doc:4].

sources.summary_ru: Статья рассматривает преимущества и проблемы натрий-ионных аккумуляторов в сравнении с литий-ионными, отмечая их важность для солнечных электростанций и экологичность .
sources.snippet: В статье исследуются преимущества и проблемы использования натрий-ионных аккумуляторов в солнечных электростанциях и сравниваются с типичными литий-ионными аккумуляторами. Представлены перспективы расширения практического применения натрий-ионных аккумуляторов в целях генерации солнечной энергии. Показано, что уникальные свойства натрий-ионных аккумуляторов, такие как их меньший риск возгорания вследствие перегревания, более высокая термическая стабильность и способность работать в экстремальных условиях, имеют важное значение с точки зрения применения в солнечных электростанциях.

sources.snippet: В статье рассматриваются современные технологии аккумуляторного хранения электрической энергии – свинцово-кислотные, литий-ионные, никель-кадмиевые и натрий-серные аккумуляторы – и их роль в интеграции возобновляемых источников энергии в электроэнергетические системы. Показано, что системы накопления энергии обеспечивают балансирование активной и реактивной мощности, стабилизацию напряжения и частоты, а также повышают устойчивость и гибкость электрических сетей.

sources.summary_ru: Sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) have undergone rapid development as a complementary technology to lithium-ion batteries due to abundant sodium resources. However, the extended charging time and low energy density pose a significant challenge to the widespread use of SIBs in electric vehicles.
sources.snippet: Sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) have undergone rapid development as a complementary technology to lithium-ion batteries due to abundant sodium resources. However, the extended charging time and low energy density pose a significant challenge to the widespread use of SIBs in electric vehicles. To overcome this hurdle, there is considerable focus on developing fast-charging anode materials with rapid Na⁺ diffusion and superior reaction kinetics.

sources.title: Unleashing the Potential of Sodium‐Ion Batteries: Current State and Future Directions for Sustainable Energy Storage
sources.summary_ru: Abstract Rechargeable sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs) are emerging as a viable alternative to lithium‐ion battery (LIB) technology, as their raw materials are economical, geographically abundant (unlike lithium), and less toxic. The matured LIB technology contributes significantly to digital civilization, from mobile electronic devices to zero electric‐vehicle emissions.
sources.snippet: In this context, SIBs have gained attention as a potential energy storage alternative, benefiting from the abundance of sodium and sharing electrochemical characteristics similar to LIBs. Furthermore, high‐entropy chemistry has emerged as a new paradigm, promising to enhance energy density and accelerate advancements in battery technology to meet the growing energy demands. This review uncovers the fundamentals, current progress, and the views on the future of SIB technologies, with a discussion focused on the design of novel materials.

sources.summary_ru: Sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) are experiencing a large-scale renaissance to supplement or replace expensive lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) and low energy density lead-acid batteries in electrical energy storage systems and other applications.
sources.snippet: Sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) are experiencing a large-scale renaissance to supplement or replace expensive lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) and low energy density lead-acid batteries in electrical energy storage systems and other applications. In this case, layered oxide materials have become one of the most popular cathode candidates for SIBs because of their low cost and comparatively facile synthesis method. However, the intrinsic shortcomings of layered oxide cathodes, which severely limit their commercialization process, urgently need to be addressed.

sources.title: Emerging Chemistry for Wide-Temperature Sodium-Ion Batteries
sources.summary_ru: The shortage of resources such as lithium and cobalt has promoted the development of novel battery systems with low cost, abundance, high performance, and efficient environmental adaptability. Due to the abundance and low cost of sodium, sodium-ion battery chemistry has drawn worldwide attention in energy storage systems.
sources.snippet: It is widely considered that wide-temperature tolerance sodium-ion batteries (WT-SIBs) can be rapidly developed due to their unique electrochemical and chemical properties. However, WT-SIBs, especially for their electrode materials and electrolyte systems, still face various challenges in harsh-temperature conditions. In this review, we focus on the achievements, failure mechanisms, fundamental chemistry, and scientific challenges of WT-SIBs. The insights of their design principles, current research, and safety issues are presented.

sources.snippet: Post-quantum cryptography has gained attention due to the need for secure cryptographic systems in the face of quantum computing. Code-based and lattice-based cryptography are two prominent approaches, both heavily studied within the NIST standardization project. Code-based cryptography -- most prominently exemplified by the McEliece cryptosystem -- is based on the hardness of decoding random linear error-correcting codes.

sources.title: Homomorphic Encryption Based on Lattice Post-Quantum Cryptography
sources.summary_ru: (d3) Предлагается схема гомоморфного шифрования на основе постквантовой решёточной криптографии, устойчивая к атакам квантовых компьютеров.
sources.snippet: As quantum computing technology continues to advance, post-quantum cryptographic methods capable of resisting quantum attacks have emerged as a critical area of focus. Given the potential vulnerability of existing homomorphic encryption methods, such as RSA, ElGamal, and Paillier, to quantum computing attacks, this study proposes a lattice-based post-quantum homomorphic encryption scheme. The approach leverages lattice cryptography to build resilience against quantum threats while enabling practical homomorphic encryption applications.

sources.title: Lattice-Based Cryptosystems and Quantum Cryptanalysis
sources.summary_ru: (d4) Описываются основы решёточных криптографических систем и их устойчивость к квантовому криптоанализу, рассматривается конкурс стандартов NIST.
sources.snippet: Lattice-Based Cryptosystems and Quantum CryptanalysisQuantum computers are probably coming, though we don't know when-and when they arrive, they will, most likely, be able to break our standard public-key cryptography algorithms. In anticipation of this possibility, cryptographers have been working on quantum-resistant public-key algorithms. The National Institute for Standards and Technology (NIST) has been hosting a competition a since 2017, and there already are several proposed standards. b Most of these are based on lattice problems.

sources.title: Evaluation and Comparison of Lattice-based Cryptosystems for a Secure Quantum Computing Era
sources.summary_ru: (d5) Сравниваются и систематически оцениваются известные решёточные криптосистемы с точки зрения безопасности, эффективности и устойчивости к квантовым угрозам.
sources.snippet: In this work, we study the most well-known lattice-based cryptosystems while a systematic evaluation and comparison is presented also, and focuses on their strengths and weaknesses.

sources.title: Post-Quantum Cryptography: An Analysis of Code-Based and Lattice-Based Cryptosystems
sources.summary_ru: (d6) Проводится сравнительный анализ двух типов постквантовых криптосистем — на основе кодов (McEliece) и на основе решеток (NTRU), рассматриваются их структуры и стойкость к квантовым атакам.
sources.snippet: Most modern cryptographic systems, such as RSA and the Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange, rely on "trapdoor" mathematical functions that are presumed to be computationally difficult with existing tools. However, quantum computers will be able to break these systems using Shor's Algorithm, necessitating the development of quantum-resistant alternatives. We first examine the McEliece cryptosystem, a code-based scheme believed to be secure against quantum attacks due to the hardness of decoding arbitrary linear codes.

sources.title: A survey on lattice-based digital signature
sources.summary_ru: Abstract Lattice-based digital signature has become one of the widely recognized post-quantum algorithms because of its simple algebraic operation, rich mathematical foundation and worst-case security, and also an important tool for constructing cryptography.
sources.snippet: Abstract Lattice-based digital signature has become one of the widely recognized post-quantum algorithms because of its simple algebraic operation, rich mathematical foundation and worst-case security, and also an important tool for constructing cryptography. This survey explores lattice-based digital signatures, a promising post-quantum resistant alternative to traditional schemes relying on factoring or discrete logarithm problems, which face increasing risks from quantum computing.

Therefore, in addition to saving energy, such a technology can help reduce labor costs by using fewer drivers to fulfill the same demand.

sources.summary_ru: Platooning technology is renowned for its precise vehicle control, traffic flow optimization, and energy efficiency enhancement. However, in large-scale mixed platoons, vehicle heterogeneity and unpredictable traffic conditions lead to virtual bottlenecks.
sources.snippet: Platooning technology is renowned for its precise vehicle control, traffic flow optimization, and energy efficiency enhancement. However, in large-scale mixed platoons, vehicle heterogeneity and unpredictable traffic conditions lead to virtual bottlenecks. These bottlenecks result in reduced traffic throughput and increased energy consumption within the platoon. To address these challenges, we introduce a decision-making strategy based on nested graph reinforcement learning. This strategy improves collaborative decision-making, ensuring energy efficiency and alleviating congestion.

sources.title: Safe and Operationally Efficient Longitudinal Control of Autonomous Truck Platoons
sources.summary_ru: This paper presents a hierarchical longitudinal control architecture for autonomous truck platoons that jointly addresses safety, string stability, and economic efficiency.
sources.snippet: This paper presents a hierarchical longitudinal control architecture for autonomous truck platoons that jointly addresses safety, string stability, and economic efficiency. The framework integrates a high-rate safety projection filter, a spacing-regulation layer based on a lag-aware proportional-integral-derivative (PID) controller, and a slow-timescale economic optimizer balancing fuel consumption and travel time.

sources.title: Large-Area Fabrication of a Highly Stable Wearable Temperature Sensing System via Dispensing Printing: Carbon-Based Electronic Ink, Self-Charging Sensing, and Remote Human Monitoring.
sources.summary_ru: Статья посвящена созданию высокоточной носимой системы мониторинга температуры на основе дисперсионной печати углеродных чернил и интеграции с IoT для удаленного контроля .
sources.snippet: With the rapid advancement of flexible electronics in healthcare diagnostics, real-time body temperature monitoring using electronic skin has become increasingly important for assessing and predicting human health status. Currently, most self-charging temperature sensing systems rely on thermoelectric effects, which are limited to transient detection and lack the resolution necessary to track subtle fluctuations in body temperature (e. g. , <0. 1 °C), thus constraining their practical use in wearable temperature monitoring.

sources.title: Direct-Ink-Writing Multifunctional Flexible Robotic Electronic Skin.
sources.summary_ru: Представлена электронная кожа для роботов, изготовленная методом прямой печати чернилами, позволяющая обнаруживать давление, температуру и сдвиговые силы с высокой чувствительностью и стабильностью .
sources.snippet: Electronic skin for robotics often suffers from limited scalability, high fabrication costs, and inflexible designs, restricting its ability to support multimodal sensing and customization. To address these challenges, we propose a robotic e-skin fabricated using direct-ink-writing technology that enables rapid customization and scalable production of multimodal sensors. The e-skin can detect pressure, temperature, and shear forces through a facile sensor design modification without additional complex fabrication steps.

sources.title: A Printed Microscopic Universal Gradient Interface for Super Stretchable Strain-Insensitive Bioelectronics
sources.summary_ru: Статья описывает метод печати сверхрастяжимых электронных биодатчиков с интерфейсом, нечувствительным к деформации, для точного мониторинга физиологических сигналов на коже .
sources.snippet: Stretchable electronics capable of conforming to nonplanar and dynamic human body surfaces are central for creating implantable and on-skin devices for high-fidelity monitoring of diverse physiological signals. While various strategies have been developed to produce stretchable devices, the signals collected from such devices are often highly sensitive to local strain, resulting in inevitable convolution with surface strain-induced motion artifacts that are difficult to distinguish from intrinsic physiological signals.

sources.summary_ru: Flexible capacitive pressure sensors are crucial for applications in electronic skin, artificial intelligence, and wearable medical devices. In this work, an ink‐jet printing and electrodeposition coupling technique is introduced to fabricate pattern electrodes on silk fibroin and polyurethane (SF‐PU) composite films. The addition of PU can improve the chemical properties of SF film while maintaining its considerable permeability and biocompatibility.

However, developing E-textiles with triboelectric properties involves a multi-step process and a complex device structure, which is unsuitable for actual wearables. Also, the cellulose-based fabrics with the highest wearability are unsuitable for TENG fabrication, limiting the usage to synthetic fabrics.

sources.title: Skin Controlled Electronic and Neuromorphic Tattoos
sources.summary_ru: Wearable human activity sensors developed in the past decade show a distinct trend of becoming thinner and more imperceptible while retaining their electrical qualities, with graphene e-tattoos, as the ultimate example. A persistent challenge in modern wearables, however, is signal degradation due to the distance between the sensor's recording site and the signal transmission medium.
sources.snippet: Wearable human activity sensors developed in the past decade show a distinct trend of becoming thinner and more imperceptible while retaining their electrical qualities, with graphene e-tattoos, as the ultimate example. A persistent challenge in modern wearables, however, is signal degradation due to the distance between the sensor's recording site and the signal transmission medium. To address this, we propose here to directly utilize human skin as a signal transmission medium as well as using low-cost gel electrodes for rapid probing of 2D transistor-based wearables.

cards.description_ru: Технология MXENE Ti3C2Tx Ink представляет собой методику производства чернил на основе двумерных материалов, таких как Ti3C2Tx, для печати электронных компонентов. Эти чернила позволяют формировать стабильные и высокопроизводительные электронные устройства, включая транзисторы и мемристоры, непосредственно на гибких подложках. Чернила обладают высокой электропроводностью, устойчивостью к окружающей среде благодаря гидрофобности и возможностью интеграции в логические схемы и ячейки памяти [doc:4]. Методики включают использование функциональных лигандов для улучшения стабильности дисперсии и устойчивости к деградации [doc:4], а также печать методом электогидродинамики для формирования тонких слоев [doc:4].
cards.advantage_ru: Потенциальным преимуществом технологии является возможность создания экологически стабильных и экономически эффективных решений для гибкой электроники, способных функционировать в различных условиях эксплуатации. Использование чернил позволяет упростить производство, снизить стоимость и повысить производительность устройств за счет улучшенных электрических характеристик и устойчивости к внешним факторам.
cards.case_example_ru: Исследователи продемонстрировали создание полностью растворимой электроники с использованием функциональизированных чернил MXENE Ti3C2Tx. Электроды из AD-MXene превосходят вакуумно-напыленные золотые и алюминиевые электроды, обеспечивая тонкопленочные транзисторы с хорошей экологической стабильностью благодаря своей гидрофобности [doc:4].

sources.title: A library of 2D electronic material inks synthesized by liquid-metal-assisted intercalation of crystal powders
sources.summary_ru: Статья описывает синтез библиотеки двумерных полупроводниковых чернил путем жидкометаллической интеркаляции кристаллических порошков для создания гибкой электроники .
sources.snippet: Abstract Solution-processable 2D semiconductor inks based on electrochemical molecular intercalation and exfoliation of bulk layered crystals using organic cations has offered an alternative pathway to low-cost fabrication of large-area flexible and wearable electronic devices. However, the growth of large-piece bulk crystals as starting material relies on costly and prolonged high-temperature process, representing a critical roadblock towards practical and large-scale applications.

sources.title: Scalable, universal and conformal direct electrodes microprinting for high-performance van der Waals-integrated two-dimensional electronics and flexible applications
sources.summary_ru: Представлена микротипографская техника прямого нанесения электродов для двумерных гибких электронных устройств с рекордной подвижностью носителей заряда .
sources.snippet: Two-dimensional (2D) materials with extraordinary electrical properties, hold promising for large-scale, flexible electronics. However, their device performance could be hindered due to the excessive defects introduced via traditional electrode integration processes. Transfer printing techniques have been developed for van der Waals contacts integration, while existing techniques encounter limitations in achieving conformal electrode transfer and compatibility with flexible devices.

sources.title: Wafer-scale Integration of Single-Crystalline MoS$_2$ for Flexible Electronics Enabled by Oxide Dry-transfer

sources.snippet: Atomically thin, single-crystalline transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) grown via chemical vapor deposition (CVD) on sapphire substrates exhibit exceptional mechanical and electrical properties, positioning them as excellent channel materials for flexible electronics. However, conventional wet-transfer processes for integrating these materials onto flexible substrates often introduce surface contamination, significantly degrading device performance.

sources.title: Functionalized MXene ink enables environmentally stable printed electronics
sources.summary_ru: Исследуется функционализированная паста MXENE Ti3C2Tx для создания стабильной печатной электроники с превосходящими характеристиками по сравнению с традиционными материалами .
sources.snippet: Here, authors demonstrate the electrohydrodynamic printing of alkylated 3,4-dihydroxy-L-phenylalanine functionalized MXene (AD-MXene) ink. The AD-MXene outperforms vacuum-deposited Au and Al electrodes, providing thin film transistors with good environmental stability due to its hydrophobicity. Establishing dependable, cost-effective electrical connections is vital for enhancing device performance and shrinking electronic circuits.

sources.title: Inkjet-Printed High-Yield, Reconfigurable, and Recyclable Memristors on Paper
sources.summary_ru: Статья рассматривает создание рециклируемых мемристоров на бумаге с помощью струйной печати, демонстрируя высокую выходную эффективность и устойчивость .
sources.snippet: Reconfigurable memristors featuring neural and synaptic functions hold great potential for neuromorphic circuits by simplifying system architecture, cutting power consumption, and boosting computational efficiency. Their additive manufacturing on sustainable substrates offers unique advantages for future electronics, including low environmental impact. Here, exploiting structure-property relationship of MoS2 nanoflake-based resistive layer, we present paper-based, inkjet-printed, reconfigurable memristors.

sources.title: Chemically Tailored Growth of 2D Semiconductors via Hybrid Metal-Organic Chemical Vapor Deposition
sources.summary_ru: Работа описывает гибридный метод химического осаждения из газовой фазы для роста двумерных полупроводников с контролируемой морфологией и допированием .
sources.snippet: Two-dimensional (2D) semiconducting transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) are an exciting platform for new excitonic physics and next-generation electronics, creating a strong demand to understand their growth, doping, and heterostructures. Despite significant progress in solid-source (SS-) and metal-organic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD), further optimization is necessary to grow highly crystalline 2D TMDCs with controlled doping.

sources.snippet: In this study, A colloidal solution of MXene containing multi and single-layered Ti3C2Tx was prepared by in-situ HF etching method from the precursor compound of Ti3AlC2. After ultrasonication, the as-prepared MXene ink appears from a green to a black solution. The as-prepared black powder of Ti3C2Tx in liquid and powder is further characterized by XRD, SEM, EDAX, and Electrical property characterization. We presented the detailed methodology for the MXene ink preparation and its electrical property characterization.

sources.title: Solution-Processed Inks with Fillers of NbS$_3$ Quasi-One-Dimensional Charge-Density-Wave Material
sources.summary_ru: Исследование посвящено созданию чернил с наполнителем NbS₃ для изучения эффектов плотности заряда и фазовых переходов в будущих электронных устройствах .
sources.snippet: We report on the solution processing and testing of electronic ink comprised of quasi-one-dimensional NbS$_3$ charge-density-wave fillers. The ink was prepared by liquid-phase exfoliation of NbS$_3$ crystals into high-aspect ratio quasi-1D fillers dispersed in a mixture of isopropyl alcohol and ethylene glycol solution. The results of the electrical measurements of two-terminal electronic test structures printed on silicon substrates reveal resistance anomalies in the temperature range of ~330 K to 370 K.

cards.description_ru: Технология гибкой и растягиваемой электроники основана на использовании ультратонких материалов с высокой механической прочностью и адаптивностью, характеризующихся легкостью конструкции и отличной совместимостью с поверхностью тела человека. Такие устройства отличаются возможностью интеграции множества функций, миниатюризацией и комфортом при ношении. Важную роль играют низкомерные наноструктуры, обладающие уникальными механическими, электрическими и оптическими свойствами, позволяющие создавать трехмерные интегрированные системы с высокой плотностью компонентов и энергоэффективностью [doc:7]. Гибкая электроника активно исследуется для медицинских приложений, робототехники и интерфейсов взаимодействия человека с машиной.
cards.advantage_ru: Преимуществом гибкой и растягиваемой электроники является возможность создания устройств с высокой степенью интеграции, обеспечивающих комфортное прилегание к телу, многофункциональность и высокую плотность размещения компонентов, что открывает перспективы для развития носимых сенсоров, медицинских диагностических систем и интерактивных интерфейсов нового поколения.
cards.case_example_ru: Исследуются методы создания трехмерно-интегрированных гибких и растягиваемых сенсорных систем на базе низкомерных наноструктур, способных обеспечивать высокую плотность размещения компонентов, энергоэффективность и многофункциональный характер устройств [doc:7].

sources.title: Revolutionizing wearable technology: advanced fabrication techniques for body-conformable electronics
sources.summary_ru: Статья рассматривает современные методы изготовления носимой электроники, которая идеально повторяет контуры человеческого тела, обсуждая ключевые подходы и перспективы развития.
sources.snippet: Traditional rigid electronic fabrication technologies fall short of meeting these requirements, necessitating the exploration of advanced flexible fabrication technologies that offer new possibilities for designing and fabricating flexible and stretchable electronic products, particularly in wearable devices. Over time, the continuous development of innovative fabrication techniques has ushered in significant improvements in the design freedom, lightweight, seamless integration, and multifunctionality of wearable electronics.

sources.title: 2D Materials in Flexible Electronics: Recent Advances and Future Prospectives
sources.summary_ru: Обзор посвящен использованию двумерных материалов в гибкой электронике, подчеркивая их уникальные свойства и потенциал для создания инновационных электронных устройств.
sources.snippet: Flexible electronics have recently gained considerable attention due to their potential to provide new and innovative solutions to a wide range of challenges in various electronic fields. These electronics require specific material properties and performance because they need to be integrated into a variety of surfaces or folded and rolled for newly formatted electronics.

sources.title: Porous Conductive Textiles for Wearable Electronics
sources.summary_ru: Статья рассматривает пористые проводящие ткани как платформу для носимых электронных устройств, освещая их преимущества, методы производства и примеры применения.
sources.snippet: Among these, porous conductive textiles (PCTs) have emerged as an ideal material platform for wearable electronics, owing to their light weight, flexibility, permeability, and wearing comfort. This Review aims to present a comprehensive overview of the progress and state of the art of utilizing PCTs for the design and fabrication of a wide variety of wearable electronic devices and their integrated wearable systems. To begin with, we elucidate how PCTs revolutionize the form factors of wearable electronics.

sources.title: Soft Fiber Electronics Based on Semiconducting Polymer
sources.summary_ru: Обзор посвящен электронным волокнам на основе полупроводящих полимеров, их применению в носимых и имплантируемых устройствах, а также методам изготовления таких волокон.
sources.snippet: Fibers, originating from nature and mastered by human, have woven their way throughout the entire history of human civilization. Recent developments in semiconducting polymer materials have further endowed fibers and textiles with various electronic functions, which are attractive in applications such as information interfacing, personalized medicine, and clean energy. Owing to their ability to be easily integrated into daily life, soft fiber electronics based on semiconducting polymers have gained popularity recently for wearable and implantable applications.

sources.title: Green Flexible Electronics: Natural Materials, Fabrication, and Applications
sources.summary_ru: Статья посвящена зеленой гибкой электронике на основе натуральных материалов, рассматривая достижения в области дизайна, производства и применения экологичных электронных компонентов.
sources.snippet: The emergence of plastic electronics satisfies the increasing demand for flexible electronics. However, it has caused severe ecological problems. Flexible electronics based on natural materials are increasing to hopefully realize the "green" and eco-friendly concept. Herein, recent advances in the design and fabrication of green flexible electronics are reviewed. First, this review comprehensively introduces various natural materials and derivatives, focusing particularly on fibroin and silk, wood and paper, plants, and biomass.

sources.title: Flexible piezoelectric materials and strain sensors for wearable electronics and artificial intelligence applications
sources.summary_ru: Обзор охватывает пьезоэлектрические материалы и датчики деформации для носимых устройств и применений в искусственном интеллекте, фокусируясь на современных материалах и стратегиях улучшения их характеристик.
sources.snippet: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, the applications of flexible piezoelectric sensors in health monitoring and human-machine interaction have attracted increasing attention. Recent advances in flexible materials and fabrication technologies have promoted practical applications of wearable devices, enabling their assembly in various forms such as ultra-thin films, electronic skins and electronic tattoos.

sources.title: Low-dimensional nanostructures for monolithic 3D-integrated flexible and stretchable electronics
sources.summary_ru: Статья рассматривает использование низкомерных наноструктур для создания трехмерно-интегрированной гибкой и растягиваемой электроники, акцентируя внимание на перспективах повышения плотности и функциональности устройств.
sources.snippet: Finally, we discuss the technical challenges and advanced methodologies involved in the design and optimization of low-dimensional nanostructures, to achieve monolithic 3D-integrated flexible/stretchable multi-sensory systems.

sources.title: Wearable Electronics Based on Stretchable Organic Semiconductors
sources.summary_ru: Обзор посвящен носимым устройствам на основе растяжимых органических полупроводников, отмечая их преимущества, методы изготовления и потенциальные области применения.
sources.snippet: Wearable electronics are attracting increasing interest due to the emerging Internet of Things (IoT). Compared to their inorganic counterparts, stretchable organic semiconductors (SOSs) are promising candidates for wearable electronics due to their excellent properties, including light weight, stretchability, dissolubility, compatibility with flexible substrates, easy tuning of electrical properties, low cost, and low temperature solution processability for large-area printing.

cards.description_ru: Direct Ink Write (DIW) — метод аддитивного производства, позволяющий точно и последовательно наносить слои электропроводящих материалов для создания гибких электронных устройств. Технология основана на использовании специальных чернил, обеспечивающих механическую гибкость и электрическую проводимость, например, композитных полимерных и металлических составов [doc:1]. С помощью DIW возможно создание многослойных конструкций, включая подложки, изоляторы, соединительные элементы и электроды [doc:1]. Чернила могут содержать эластомерные материалы, серебряные частицы, наноматериалы и биоразлагаемые компоненты, что расширяет область применения от носимых устройств до медицинских имплантатов [doc:5].
cards.advantage_ru: Технология DIW позволяет создавать многофункциональные, высоко деформируемые и устойчивые электронные системы, открывая путь к новым поколениям носимых и адаптивных электронных устройств благодаря высокой точности нанесения слоев и интеграции различных функциональных компонентов.
cards.case_example_ru: Исследователи разработали методику DIW-печати многофункциональной платформы электронного текстиля с использованием датчиков деформации и межслойных электродов. Напечатанный датчик деформации продемонстрировал высокую чувствительность с коэффициентом Гага 11,07 и стабильную работу под повторяющейся механической нагрузкой. Электроды обеспечивали стабильное сопротивление (0,2–0,4 Ом) даже при растяжении и давлении, что позволило интегрировать их в умную одежду, маски и перчатки для мониторинга движений тела и дыхания [doc:8].

sources.title: Direct-ink-writing of highly deformable, multi-layered electrical devices using elastomer-based dual inks
sources.summary_ru: Статья рассматривает DIW-методику создания гибких многослойных электрических устройств с использованием эластомерных чернил, обеспечивающих деформационную устойчивость и электрическую стабильность .
sources.snippet: In this study, we present a direct-ink-writing (DIW) approach utilising dual-functional inks to fabricate highly deformable, multi-layered electronic devices. A styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene (SEBS) elastomer ink ensures mechanical flexibility, while a SEBS-silver (SEBS-Ag) composite ink provides electrical conductivity. The printed conductive structures exhibit conductivities of approximately 3. 37 × 105 S·m−1, and the total conductance increases linearly as the number of printed layers increases.

sources.title: Direct Ink Writing of Conductive Hydrogels
sources.summary_ru: Обзор посвящен применению DIW-технологии для печати электропроводящих гидрогелей, используемых в гибкой электронике и медицине .
sources.snippet: In recent years, DIW of conductive hydrogels has gained significant attention across various fields, ranging from biomedical scaffolds to flexible electronics. Conductive hydrogels are a category of hydrogels which exhibit conductivity in their wet and/or dry state. Precursors like conductive polymers, metallic nanoparticles, and carbon‐based materials can be used to induce electronic and/or ionic conductivity in hydrogels. This review presents a comprehensive overview of conductive hydrogels demonstrating printability using the DIW technique.

sources.title: Direct Ink Writing of Nanocellulose and PEDOT:PSS for Flexible Electronic Patterned and Supercapacitor Papers
sources.summary_ru: Статья описывает использование DIW для изготовления электропроводящей бумаги с применением наноклетчатки и PEDOT:PSS, пригодной для суперконденсаторов и носимой электроники .
sources.snippet: The conductor patterns are integrated in the bulk of the paper, while non‐conductive sections are used as support to form free‐standing paper. The strong interface between the patterns of electronic patterned paper gives mechanical stability for practical handling. The conductive paper‐based electrode has 202 S cm−1 and is capable of handling electric current up to 0. 7 A, which can be used for high‐power devices. Printed supercapacitor papers show high specific energy of 4. 05 Wh kg−1, specific power of 4615 W kg−1 at 0. 06 A g−1, and capacitance retention above 95% after 2000 cycles.

sources.title: Direct‐Ink‐Write 3D Printing of Programmable Micro‐Supercapacitors from MXene‐Regulating Conducting Polymer Inks
sources.summary_ru: Исследование посвящено созданию программируемых микро-суперконденсаторов методом DIW с использованием композитов PEDOT:PSS/MXene, демонстрирующих высокие характеристики емкости и стабильности .
sources.snippet: Herein, a direct ink writing 3D printing approach for preparing all‐printed flexible micro‐supercapacitors is demonstrated using rationally designed poly(3,4‐ethylenedioxythiophene):polystyrene sulfonate (PEDOT:PSS)/MXene composite gels as inks without the tedious processes and toxic organic additives. Among the printable inks, the homogeneously distributed MXene nanosheets can boost the printability of PEDOT:PSS solution and also regulate the interconnected electronic structures of the PEDOT:PSS undergoing a micellar to linear structure transition.

sources.title: Cottonseed‐Derived Reusable Bio‐Carbon Gel Ink for DIW Printing Soft Electronic Textiles
sources.summary_ru: Представлен новый подход к DIW-печати мягких электронных тканей с использованием биоуглеродных гелевых чернил на основе семян хлопка, обладающих высокой проводимостью и растяжимостью .
sources.snippet: Soft electronics textiles have garnered global attention for their wearability and promising applications in healthcare, energy devices, and artificial intelligence. Recently, direct‐ink‐writing (DIW) technology has shown a growing trend because of its controllability, ease of fabrication, and efficiency. However, the design novelty of printable ink for soft electronic textiles is severely hampered by the intrinsic challenges of integrating printability, conductivity, stretchability, biocompatibility, and durability.

sources.title: Inkjet Printable Conductive Activated Carbon Ink from Sustainable Sources
sources.summary_ru: Статья посвящена разработке экологически устойчивого активированного углеродного чернила для струйной печати, предназначенного для создания проводящих рисунков и сенсоров .
sources.snippet: Inkjet printing offers an attractive manufacturing method for flexible and large-area electronics, yet formulating sustainable inks not derived from fossil fuels represents a major challenge toward environmentally friendly technologies. Here, we present a conductive ink formulated for inkjet printing, consisting only of renewable and nontoxic components, namely electrically conductive activated carbon nanoparticles, ethyl cellulose as binder and stabilizer, and ethanol-terpineol mixture as the dispersant.

sources.title: Inkjet printing of silver conductive ink on textiles for electronic applications: impact of ink formulation on electrical performances of the ink
sources.summary_ru: Работа описывает синтез и печать серебряных проводников на текстильных материалах методом струйной печати для создания гибких электронных компонентов .
sources.snippet: Printed electronics technology is one of the most dynamic in the world, allowing for the low-cost fabrication of electronic networks on textile substrates using the inkjet printing technique which is commonly used in various industries. In the field of formulation of conductive inks, silver nanoparticles are generally used as precursors that confer electrical conductivity to the printed patterns. In the present work, we synthesized silver nanoparticles by an ecological reduction method and then dispersed them in a PEG/Glycerol mixture to prepare a conductive ink.

sources.title: Fabrication of multifunctional wearable interconnect E-textile platform using direct ink writing (DIW) 3D printing
sources.summary_ru: Статья представляет разработку многофункциональной платформы электронного текстиля с датчиком деформации и межслойными электродами, созданными методом DIW-печати, для применения в носимых устройствах .
sources.snippet: Textiles, integral to human life for centuries, have recently garnered significant interest for electronic applications. However, traditional fabrication methods for electronic textiles (E-textiles) are typically complex. This research introduces an innovative approach utilizing Direct Ink Writing (DIW) 3D printing to develop multifunctional wearable electronic textiles. Specifically, the study addresses the creation of a strain sensor and an interconnect electrode directly printed onto textile substrates.

Чернила используются в составе пленочных слоев электронных устройств, таких как OLED-дисплеи и жидкокристаллические панели [doc:2]. Важными задачами являются улучшение адгезии, предотвращение засорения сопел принтера и ускорение полимеризации чернил [doc:3]. Электронные чернила применяются также в системах защиты приватности камер и модулях экранов [docs:4, 6].
cards.advantage_ru: Технология позволяет создавать энергоэффективные, легкие и гибкие устройства отображения информации, а также обеспечивает возможность изменения состояния экранов под воздействием электрического поля, что открывает перспективы для умной упаковки, носимых устройств и интерактивных поверхностей.

sources.snippet: In this paper, we propose a tightly-coupled multi-modal multi-LiDAR-inertial SLAM system for surveying and mapping tasks. By taking advantage of both solid-state and spinnings LiDARs, and built-in inertial measurement units (IMU), we achieve both robust and low-drift ego-estimation as well as high-resolution maps in diverse challenging indoor environments (e. g. , small, featureless rooms). First, we use spatial-temporal calibration modules to align the timestamp and calibrate extrinsic parameters between sensors.

sources.snippet: We have proposed, to the best of our knowledge, the first-of-its-kind LiDAR-Inertial-Visual-Fused simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system with a strong place recognition capacity. Our proposed SLAM system is consist of visual-inertial odometry (VIO) and LiDAR inertial odometry (LIO) subsystems. We propose the LIO subsystem utilizing the measurement from the LiDAR and the inertial sensors to build the local odometry map, and propose the VIO subsystem which takes in the visual information to construct the 2D-3D associated map.

sources.title: Environment-Adaptive Solid-State LiDAR-Inertial Odometry
sources.summary_ru: Исследуется адаптивная система твердотельного лидар-инерциального одометра для точной локализации в экстремальных условиях.
sources.snippet: Solid-state LiDAR-inertial SLAM has attracted significant attention due to its advantages in speed and robustness. However, achieving accurate mapping in extreme environments remains challenging due to severe geometric degeneracy and unreliable observations, which often lead to ill-conditioned optimization and map inconsistencies. To address these challenges, we propose an environment-adaptive solid-state LiDAR-inertial odometry that integrates local normal-vector constraints with degeneracy-aware map maintenance to enhance localization accuracy.

sources.snippet: Most of the existing LiDAR-inertial navigation systems are based on frame-to-map registrations, leading to inconsistency in state estimation. The newest solid-state LiDAR with a non-repetitive scanning pattern makes it possible to achieve a consistent LiDAR-inertial estimator by employing a frame-to-frame data association. In this letter, we propose a robust and consistent frame-to-frame LiDAR-inertial navigation system (FF-LINS) for solid-state LiDARs.

sources.snippet: Odometry is crucial for robot navigation, particularly in situations where global positioning methods like global positioning system (GPS) are unavailable. The main goal of odometry is to predict the robot's motion and accurately determine its current location. Various sensors, such as wheel encoder, inertial measurement unit (IMU), camera, radar, and Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR), are used for odometry in robotics. LiDAR, in particular, has gained attention for its ability to provide rich three-dimensional (3D) data and immunity to light variations.

sources.snippet: Objects detection and tracking using 3-D LiDAR has gained momentum lately while it has not been extensively applied, and the main challenge is that conventional mechanical LiDAR is expensive and it is difficult for single sensor to obtain good tracking performance over a long period of time. In this article, we propose a multisensor fusion 3-D objects detection and tracking framework using solid-state LiDAR and RGB camera. We use a low-cost solid-state LiDAR with irregular scan pattern and propose a universal clustering method which determines the searching radius by laser density and range.

This paper presents Channel-Time Patch Time-Series Transformer (CT-PatchTST), a novel deep learning model designed to provide long-term, high-fidelity forecasts of wind and solar power.
sources.snippet: This paper presents Channel-Time Patch Time-Series Transformer (CT-PatchTST), a novel deep learning model designed to provide long-term, high-fidelity forecasts of wind and solar power. Unlike conventional time-series models, CT-PatchTST captures both temporal dependencies and inter-channel correlations-features that are critical for effective energy storage planning, control, and dispatch.

It provides a detailed analysis of technological progress in various ESDs and the critical role of power conversion, control, energy management, and cooling systems in optimizing HESS performance.

sources.title: Predictive Reliability Assessment of Distribution Grids with Residential Distributed Energy Resources
sources.summary_ru: Статья посвящена методике оценки надёжности распределительных сетей с учётом внедрения домашних возобновляемых источников энергии и накопителей, используя вероятностный подход и моделирование Монте-Карло.
sources.snippet: Distribution system end users are transforming from passive to active participants, marked by the push towards widespread adoption of edge-level Distributed Energy Resources (DERs). This paper addresses the challenges in distribution system planning arising from these dynamic changes. We introduce a bottom-up probabilistic approach that integrates these edge-level DERs into the reliability evaluation process.

sources.title: Valuing Distributed Energy Resources for Non-Wires Alternatives
sources.summary_ru: Исследуется применение распределённых энергетических ресурсов как альтернативы новым сетям, предлагается математический фреймворк для оптимизации инвестиций и снижения затрат операторов энергосистем.
sources.snippet: Distributed energy resources (DER) as non-wires alternatives, regardless of owner, have the potential to reduce system operating costs and delay system upgrades. However, it is difficult to determine the appropriate economic signal to incentivize DER investors to install capacity that will benefit both the DER investors and the system operator. In an attempt to determine this co-optimal price signal, we present a bilevel optimization framework for determining the least cost solution to distribution system over-loads.

sources.title: Memory-Based Set Point Modulation for Improved Transient Response of Distributed Energy Resources
sources.summary_ru: Предлагается улучшение переходных характеристик распределённых энергоресурсов через модификацию уставки с использованием памяти ошибок предыдущих выборок, что повышает эффективность управления при низких частотах дискретизации.
sources.snippet: As the composition of the power grid evolves to integrate more renewable generation, its reliance on distributed energy resources (DER) is increasing. Existing DERs are often controlled with proportional integral (PI) controllers that, if not properly tuned or if system parameters change, exhibit sluggish performance or large overshoot. The use of set point automatic adjustment with correction-enabled (SPAACE) with a linear predictor improves the transient response of these DERs without the need to access the PI controller parameters.

sources.snippet: The article examines the role of digital twin technology as a key instrument of the digital transformation of the energy sector. In economic science, N. D. The study applies a systematic analysis of scientific literature and practical cases of digital twin implementation in the energy sector, correlating these findings with the phases of long economic cycles.

sources.title: Control Systems for Low-Inertia Power Grids: A Survey on Virtual Power Plants
sources.summary_ru: Обзор механизмов контроля и архитектур виртуальных электростанций, фокусирующийся на динамических аспектах управления в масштабе подчасового времени.
sources.snippet: Virtual Power Plants (VPPs) have emerged as a modern real-time energy management architecture that seeks to synergistically coordinate an aggregation of renewable and non-renewable generation systems to overcome some of the fundamental limitations of traditional power grids dominated by synchronous machines. In this survey paper, we review the different existing and emerging feedback control mechanisms and architectures used for the real-time operation of VPPs.

sources.title: Experimental Validation of a Dynamic Virtual Power Plant Concept Based on Multiple-Converter Power Hardware-In-the-Loop Test Bench
sources.summary_ru: Экспериментальное подтверждение концепции динамической виртуальной электростанции для быстрого регулирования частоты и напряжения с помощью разнородных распределённых энергетических ресурсов.
sources.snippet: Recently, the concept of dynamic virtual power plants (DVPP) has been proposed to collectively provide desired dynamic ancillary services such as fast frequency and voltage control by a heterogeneous ensemble of distributed energy resources (DER). This paper presents an experimental validation of a recent DVPP control design approach on a multi-converter power hardware-in-the-loop (PHIL) test bed system.

sources.title: Assessment of the operational flexibility of virtual power plants to facilitate the integration of distributed energy resources and decision-making under uncertainty
sources.summary_ru: Методология оценки гибкости виртуальных электростанций для эффективного управления распределёнными ресурсами и принятия решений в условиях неопределённости.
sources.snippet: Distributed energy resources (DERs) are elements that actively participate in the supply of renewable energy and contribute to the decarbonization of the power system. However, they lack two factors necessary to take advantage of their operational flexibility: observability and controllability. In this sense, Virtual Power Plants (VPPs) are a feasible alternative to provide the necessary requirements for the optimal management of a set of distributed units.

sources.title: Virtual power plants: an in-depth analysis of their advancements and importance as crucial players in modern power systems
sources.summary_ru: Анализ эволюции и важности виртуальных электростанций как ключевых участников современных энергосистем, способных интегрировать возобновляемую энергию и управлять спросом.
sources.snippet: Abstract Background Virtual power plants (VPPs) represent a pivotal evolution in power system management, offering dynamic solutions to the challenges of renewable energy integration, grid stability, and demand-side management. Originally conceived as a concept to aggregate small-scale distributed energy resources, VPPs have evolved into sophisticated enablers of diverse energy assets, including solar panels, wind turbines, battery storage systems, and demand response units.

sources.snippet: We are interested in a cool automation platform for a Distributed Energy Resources (DER) for a Virtual Power Plant (VPP) using The Power Router single-unit microgrid solution that enables the seamless integration of AC and DC energy sources and loads simultaneously.

sources.title: Flexible Robust Optimal Bidding of Renewable Virtual Power Plants in Sequential Markets

sources.snippet: In this paper, a novel approach to define the optimal bidding of renewable-only virtual power plants (RVPPs) in the day-ahead, secondary reserve, and intra-day markets is proposed. To this aim, a robust optimization algorithm is developed to account for the asymmetric nature of the uncertainties that characterize the market prices, as well as the energy production of the RVPP stochastic sources and flexible demand consumption.

sources.snippet: However, unlike urban environments, agricultural fields impose distinct and unique challenges on autonomous robotic systems, such as the unstructured and dynamic nature of the environment, the rough and uneven terrain, and the resulting non-smooth robot motion. To address these challenges, this work introduces an adaptive LiDAR odometry and mapping framework tailored for autonomous agricultural mobile robots operating in complex agricultural environments.

sources.title: Resilient Navigation for Autonomous Farm Robots by Leveraging Jerk-Augmented Models with IMU-Only Disturbance Rejection
sources.summary_ru: Статья предлагает алгоритм устойчивой навигации для агророботов с использованием улучшенного фильтра Калмана и адаптации к вибрациям, проверено на реальном роботе Salin247.
sources.snippet: We evaluate the algorithm using real-world data from a Salin247 autonomous robot. Results demonstrate that jerk-augmentation combined with MTF adaptation significantly reduces 3D position Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) compared to baseline EKF models, providing superior dead-reckoning capabilities.

sources.title: Designing an Autonomous Robot for Monitoring Open-Mouth Behavior of Chickens in Commercial Chicken Farms
sources.summary_ru: Создан автономный робот для мониторинга теплового стресса у кур на фермах Тайваня путём наблюдения за открытым ртом птиц, использующий модель YOLO v7.
sources.snippet: Highlights A mobile robot was designed to autonomously cruise in typical commercial chicken farms in Taiwan. The localization of the robot reached a mean absolute error of 0. 17 m. The mobile robot automatically monitored the open-mouth behavior of chickens. A trained YOLO v7 model achieved an AP of 86. 1% in the detection of chickens with open-mouth behavior. The analysis indicates that the open-mouth behavior ratio was correlated to ambient temperature. Abstract.
